title: The headlines said supernova.
description:
The headlines said supernova. Betelgeuse, the orange shoulder of Orion, lost more than two thirds of its light by February 2020. Then it came back.

A red supergiant close enough that a telescope can resolve its actual surface. Between January and March, astronomers watched the southern half of it darken, week by week.

It was dust. The star threw off a bubble of gas. A patch of surface behind it cooled, silicon condensed, and it hid behind its own soot.

It will explode. That was not it.
